# Three Stars Group

> Three Stars Group is a vertically integrated garment manufacturer and apparel exporter in Alexandria, Egypt, founded in 2008. It makes knit and woven garments for men, ladies and kids for global brands and retailers, with 100,000 units a day of capacity across 10 production units and 3,500 sewing machines.

## Key facts

- Group companies: Three Stars Fashion, Three Stars Apparels, Golden Stars Textile and Green Point Logistics.
- Location: Street No. 7, Public Free Zone Amreya, Alexandria, Egypt 23512.
- Capacity: 100,000 units a day, 10 production units, 3,500 sewing machines, screen printing of 65,000+ pieces a day, computerized embroidery.
- Products: activewear and sportswear (hoodies, leggings, sports bras, rash guards, quarter-zips, performance tees), casualwear (T-shirts, polo shirts, pants, dresses, outerwear), kidswear, uniforms, underwear and nightwear.
- Fabrics: single jersey, rib, fleece, 100% cotton (OCS), cotton blends (CVC), polyester, recycled yarns (GRS); wovens sourced through the group's office in China.
- Private label (OEM): manufactures to the buyer's tech pack under the buyer's brand.
- Minimum order: flexible by style and fabric.
- Shipping terms: mainly duty-free FOB from Alexandria; CIF and DDP also available.
- Duty-free access: USA under the QIZ agreement, Europe under the Euro-Mediterranean agreement (EUR.1).
- Lead times: about 30 days for single jersey from stock, about 45 days for most locally sourced knit fabrics; transit about 1 week to Europe and about 3 weeks to US ports.
- Certifications: ISO 9001, WRAP Gold, Better Work, BSCI, SEDEX, Higg Index, GRS, OCS, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, FAMA (Disney), Inditex approved facility.
- Contact: info@tsf.com.eg, +20 3 4500550.
